The '''Freedom Fleet''' was a hastily-assembled fleet of transport [[Starship/Legends|starships]] created by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kerra Holt]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]]. She along with fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Gorlan Palladane]] and his supporters hijacked several [[Daimanate]] cargo ships to escape [[Chelloa]] prior to its [[Destruction of Chelloa|destruction]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] had used [[kinetic corruptor]]s to destroy Chelloa by igniting the volatile [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] shales beneath its surface as part of an attempt to trap and destroy his rival Lord [[Odion]], ruler of the [[Odionate]] Sith princedom. They succeeded in evacuating around 60,000 Chelloan civilians and slaves and fled to [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] space.
